title: 23 · faithful_wife · The Faithful Wife
lines: No weapon could touch this demon king. Not even Shiva's.
Because far away, one woman was praying for him.
And her faith was his armour.
While she believed, he could not fall.
And he knew it. So he feared nothing, and took everything.
The war with Shiva went on, and on.
So Vishnu did a thing he would be cursed for.
For one moment, she believed the wrong man was him.
On the battlefield, the shield went out.
When Vrinda saw the truth, she cursed even Vishnu.
You will turn to stone. And she walked into the fire.
"You will turn to stone." And she walked into the fire.
From her ashes grew a small green plant.
Vishnu swore he would never be worshipped without it.
She is the tulsi in every courtyard.
Faith that strong is never wasted. That is sadhana.
